dependencies.description: Payment creation returns transaction ID for retrieval
Payment capture requires transaction ID from payment creation
Payment void requires transaction ID from payment creation
Refund creation returns refund ID for retrieval
Subscription creation returns subscription ID for retrieval
Subscription deletion requires subscription ID from creation
Database reset clears invoices, so invoices list must be tested after reset
Database reset clears payments, so payments list must be tested after reset
Database reset clears refunds, so refunds list must be tested after reset
Database reset clears subscriptions, so subscriptions list must be tested after reset
